notes: Adds owner-controlled outcome capture after an Action reaches an eligible state.
Outcomes support usefulness, owner-reported result, time spent, optional notes, measurable results, follow-up date and evidence classification.
Adds transparent structured Business Memory derived only from product-relevant profile, goals, pack, Opportunity/Action history, rejection reasons, preferences and outcomes.
Initial Outcome and Business Memory domain contracts, validation policy and business-isolated endpoint design are implemented; EF integration, migration, tests and mobile remain in progress.
Business Memory remains business-isolated, inspectable and deletable where applicable; no hidden autonomous learning or external action is introduced.
PES navigation, routing, authentication, state management, design system and framework structure remain unchanged.
Runtime remains disabled outside development/test; deployment and production enablement are not authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner authorized closing VS-07, merging it and starting the next approved slice. The approved PRD maps VS-08 to Outcome Capture and Business Memory.
Authorization covers implementation and testing. Certification, merge, release, deployment and production enablement remain separately gated.
